name: r2-silu-bw-s-wbulk-e2
author: solx-loop
description: H16: the ~0.3-0.5 us that the S-band kernel spends above an empty launch is a DRAM round trip plus store acknowledgement under the dirty post-memset L2, and a different access mechanism (one-shot 1-D bulk copy) shortens it. Result: REFUTED. The S-band excess is ~0.7 us of load round trip (the same under a clean flush); stores add <= 0.08 us. The warp-level bulk copy is 0.16-0.20 us slower, so this kernel is a negative control: do NOT submit to the portal.
